description: This file defines a PHP class 'MyBugsDashlet', extending 'DashletGeneric', which represents a custom user interface component (dashlet) for viewing bugs assigned to the current user in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for initializing the dashlet, setting up search fields and columns, and rendering configuration options.

classes.name: MyBugsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet for displaying bugs assigned to the current user, with configuration options for filtering by releases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the dashlet with default search fields and columns, sets the title if not provided, and creates a new seed bean for bugs.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders configuration options for the dashlet, allowing filtering of bugs by 'fixed in release' and 'found in release' via multi-select inputs.
